verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is a full accounting system, so a month-end close checklist is a fair axis, but the evidence never documents a close checklist or review sign-off workflow. The pack only shows adjacent features: continuous auto-reconciliation, a cash/accrual accounting toggle, accountant invites, and transaction comments. None of these is a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and sign-offs through a close.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
